subject: Genetics
question: A 28 year old woman is diagnosed with Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (LHON), a disorder caused by mutations in mitochondrial DNA. She has two sons and one daughter. Her husband is healthy. Which of the following best describes the inheritance pattern of this disorder?

options.A: Only the sons will inherit the mutation.
options.B: Only the daughter will inherit the mutation.
options.C: All of her children will inherit the mitochondrial DNA mutation.
options.D: None of her children will inherit the mutation because the father is unaffected.
